strength.label: Connection strength
strength.help: Anyone you could message who would know who you are. People you met only once: weak.

tags.categoryRequired: Choose a category for this skill.
tags.pendingNotAdded: Choose a category for {{label}} and add it, or clear the text, before saving.

duplicates.title: This person may already exist
duplicates.intro: The new person was saved. These people share a phone number, email or link with them. Open them to check.

person.stale: Not confirmed for over a year

removeConnectionDialog.title: Remove the connection with {{name}}?
removeConnectionDialog.body: {{name}} stays in your network; only this connection is removed, and with it any path that went through it.

view.noContacts: No contact details are saved for this person.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: This removes the person, their contact details and all their connections. It cannot be undone.

errors.savedOnDevice: Could not reach the server. Your entry is kept on this device; try again when you are back online.
errors.invalid: Some details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a name in Arabic or English.
errors.personNotFound: The person you chose to connect to no longer exists. Pick someone else.
errors.alreadyConnected: These two people are already connected.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.mfaRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator app again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own profile.
errors.cannotDropAccount: This record belongs to a sign-in account, so it cannot be merged away. Keep it instead.
errors.linkRevoked: This link was revoked, so it cannot be renewed. Create a new link instead.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

search.idle: Type a name, a skill or a profession, or choose a filter, to search your network.
search.contactHint: Phone numbers and email addresses cannot be searched. Search by name, skill or profession.

intro.ask: Hi {{firstHop}}, do you know someone who can introduce me to {{target}}?
intro.askDirect: Hi {{firstHop}}, could you introduce me to {{target}}?
intro.copied: The message was copied. Paste it into a chat with {{name}}.
intro.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the text below and copy it.
intro.whatsappBlocked: The browser blocked WhatsApp from opening. Use the button below.

review.gone: This person no longer exists. The list was refreshed.

duplicates.intro: These people share a phone number, email or link. Keep one record and merge the other into it, or say they are different people.

mergeDialog.title: Keep {{keep}}?
mergeDialog.body: {{keep}} keeps its own details, and {{drop}} only fills in what {{keep}} is missing. Connections, skills and contact details are combined. {{drop}} is then deleted. This cannot be undone.

stale.intro: These people have not been confirmed for over a year. Confirm that their details are right, or edit them. "Send update link" gives them a link to add the people they know, with a message asking them to reply with any change to their own details, so you can edit it.

unreachable.intro: These people have no path from you. Connect each one to someone in your network.

links.intro: A contributor link lets one person add the people they know, without an account. It works for 30 days.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the link for {{name}}?
revokeDialog.body: The link stops working at once. People already added through it stay. You can create a new link later.

issued.title: Link for {{name}}
issued.warning: Copy or share this link now. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again. It works until {{date}}.
issued.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the link above and copy it.

share.message: Hi, I am adding the people I know to my network. Please add the people you know here: {{url}}
share.updateMessage: Hi, I am updating my network. Has anything about you changed (job, company, city, phone)? Just reply here and I will update it. You can also add the people you know here: {{url}}

errors.notFound: This link was not found. The list was refreshed.

export.intro: Download everything in your network: people, contact details, connections, links and tags.

json.title: JSON
json.hint: The full backup: every field exactly as stored.

csv.title: CSV
csv.hint: A zip with one CSV file per table, for spreadsheets. A cell that starts with =, +, - or @ gets a leading apostrophe, so a spreadsheet does not run it as a formula. Use JSON for an exact copy.

contribute.title: Add someone you know
contribute.intro: Add the people you know, one at a time. Each one will be connected to you.
contribute.strengthLabel: How well do you know them?
contribute.expired: This link has expired or is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
contribute.noToken: This page needs the link from your message. Open that link again.
contribute.listNote: Only the people you added during this visit are shown here.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to your private network.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is wrong.
errors.notConfigured: The app is not configured: the sign-in service address is missing.

enroll.intro: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
enroll.secretLabel: Can't scan? Enter this key in your app:

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Try the latest code.
